entendimento: The CPU specification changed from single-cycle RV32I to single-cycle RV32IM while keeping the exact same top-level entity, single-cycle execution timing, memory bus protocol, and asynchronous active-high reset. The CPU must now decode and execute the eight R-type M-extension instructions (MUL, MULH, MULHSU, MULHU, DIV, DIVU, REM, REMU) encoded under opcode 0110011 (0x33) with funct7 = 0000001 (0x01) in a single clock cycle, including exact RISC-V architectural results for division by zero and signed division overflow (-2^31 / -1) guarded before VHDL division/remainder operators.

muldiv_unit.mudanca: New combinational execution unit implementing the eight RV32M multiply, divide, and remainder operations.

decoder.mudanca: Decode opcode 0x33 with funct7 = 0000001 as valid RV32M instructions, add the 3-bit muldiv_op output, and use wb_select = "11" to select muldiv_unit writeback.

cpu.mudanca: Instantiate muldiv_unit, connect rs1_data, rs2_data, and decoder muldiv_op to it, and select muldiv_unit result for register writeback when wb_select = "11".
